tcp.description: Set up a meter reached over the network through a Modbus TCP gateway.

user.description:
A PZEM meter can be set up in two ways.

You can reach it over a serial port its RS485 terminals are wired to, which covers ports shared over the network by a serial proxy, or over the network through a gateway that speaks Modbus TCP.
